266:t_005:4.en:
$$スズネ$$
「Oh... I'm sorry... One moment I thought we were fighting the $$サイデリアル$$, and then all of a sudden a different enemy was right in front of me...」

266:t_005:6.en:
$$柿小路$$
「B-Being thrown into a bloodbath like this, out of nowhere!」

266:t_005:7.en:
$$ボス$$
「Give me a break already! It's been nothing but this lately!」

266:t_006:0.en:
$$竜馬$$
「If it's a big gathering of $$バアル$$, that's perfect! It'll make a good dress rehearsal for dealing with this so-called collapse of the universe!」

266:t_006:3.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「The world I came from got through the collapse of the universe that comes once every 12,000 years by completely wiping out the nest of $$宇宙怪獣|lc$$ at the galactic core...」

266:t_006:4.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「Everyone! Let's fight to protect this world!」

266:t_006:5.en:
$$シモン$$
「So if we crush $$バアル$$, the universe will be safe, is that it!」

266:t_006:6.en:
$$タケル$$
「If we can't even get through this, there's no way we could protect the universe...!」

266:t_006:7.en:
$$葵$$
「Then let's do it...! With everything we've got!」

266:t_006:8.en:
$$勝平$$
「I'm in! I'll show them human grit and hidden strength!」

266:t_006:9.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「We've eaten our fill, so our fighting spirit's at full tank!」

266:t_006:10.en:
$$正太郎$$
「Whatever the enemy is, let's fight!」

266:t_007:0.en:
$$ランド$$
「But be careful. This place seems to be unbelievably dangerous.」

266:t_007:1.en:
$$スズネ$$
「I-I'm detecting an enormous amount of energy from over there!」

266:t_008:0.en:
$$メール$$
「What is that?! The universe is splitting open!」

266:t_008:1.en:
$n
「It's not so much the universe... as a rift between dimensions!」

266:t_008:3.en:
$$隼人$$
「The $$宇宙怪獣$$ and the $$インベーダー#pilot$$s might be fighting each other to get their hands on it.」

266:t_008:4.en:
$$赤木$$
「They're just like the ones who come to Earth after $$次元力$$!」

266:t_008:5.en:
$$Ｆ．Ｓ．$$
「$$號$$... How much longer until we've built up enough energy to open the wormhole?」

266:t_008:7.en:
$$Ｆ．Ｓ．$$
「All units, you heard that! We fight all-out for these four minutes, and after that we withdraw with a hyperspace jump!」

266:t_008:8.en:
$$ノノ$$
「Roger! Let's go wild for those four minutes!」

266:t_008:9.en:
$$ラルク$$
「We will...! I don't have the slightest intention of ending in a place like this!」

266:t_008:10.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「Our targets are the $$宇宙怪獣$$ and the $$インベーダー#pilot$$s!」

266:t_008:11.en:
$$竜馬$$
「I'll let them know! In the end, it's humanity that survives!!」

266:t_009:1.en:
$$Ｆ．Ｓ．$$
「All units, shake off the enemy and assemble at the designated point!」

266:t_010:0.en:
$$竜馬$$
「You got lucky, $$バアル$$! Next time we meet, we'll fight it out to the very end!」

266:t_010:1.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「Of course, and even then, we're the ones who'll win!」

266:t_010:2.en:
$$厚井$$
「Those two are quite bold, aren't they?」

266:t_010:3.en:
$$柿小路$$
「Young people really ought to be like this.」

266:t_010:4.en:
$$ランド$$
「You two are still young, Executive Director, Managing Director!」

266:t_010:5.en:
$$赤木$$
「That's right! You didn't give up a single step even in front of a horde of $$バアル$$!」

266:t_010:8.en:
$$隼人$$
「Maybe the ones who are young are humanity on Earth as a whole...」

266:t_010:9.en:
$$弁慶$$
「Now that we've met Dr. $$早乙女#getter$$ and $$武蔵$$, I kind of get what you're trying to say.」

266:t_012:0.en:
$$渓$$
「$$號$$! Did you open the wormhole?!」

266:t_012:3.en:
$$ＷＩＬＬ$$
「Distortion of the dimensional boundary line confirmed. This is a pattern completely different from any transfer observed until now.」

266:t_012:4.en:
$$Ｆ．Ｓ．$$
「All units, return! A $$時空震動|lc$$ is about to hit!!」

266:t_012:6.en:
$$スズネ$$
(It's beginning... No, is it the end...?)

266:t_014:0.en:
$$凱$$
「The $$インベーダー#pilot$$s are showing up again!」

266:t_014:1.en:
$$渓$$
「Bring it on! Might as well use this chance to fight like we mean to take down every $$インベーダー#pilot$$ here!」

266:t_015:1.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「It seems the $$宇宙怪獣$$ are treating the $$インベーダー#pilot$$s as a higher-priority target than us.」

266:t_015:2.en:
$$ノノ$$
「Ugh...! Getting ignored is somehow really frustrating!」

266:t_015:3.en:
$$ラルク$$
「Then we'll make it so they can't ignore us! By beating those guys down!」

266:t_100:0.en:
$$竜馬$$
($$ゲッター線$$, my ass...! And what the hell is $$シンカ$$ supposed to be!)

266:t_100:1.en:
$$竜馬$$
(I live the way my own heart commands me! No way I'm doing whatever the $$ゲッター線$$ tell me!)

266:t_101:0.en:
$$渓$$
「What did you and my old man talk about, $$號$$?」

266:t_101:1.en:
$$號$$
「About my mission, and $$ゲッター$$ Robo's.」

266:t_101:3.en:
$$號$$
「To me, it's the closest and most important duty there is.」

266:t_101:4.en:
$$渓$$
「I don't really get it, but let's do our best together!」

266:t_101:5.en:
$$凱$$
(Ugh... Looks like I'm the only one being left out again...)

266:t_102:0.en:
$$ノリコ$$
(Big Sis... Now, for the first time, I understand why I came to this world.)

266:t_102:1.en:
$$ノリコ$$
(There are $$宇宙怪獣|lc$$ in this world too... $$ガンバスター$$ and I came here to fight them, didn't we?)

266:t_102:2.en:
$$ノリコ$$
(I'll do my best, Big Sis...! With the fire of the two of us, you and me, I'll definitely protect humanity!)

266:t_103:0.en:
$$ラルク$$
「Looks like the $$宇宙怪獣|lc$$ we were fighting were limited to the Solar System...!」

266:t_103:2.en:
$$ラルク$$
「But they're still $$宇宙怪獣|lc$$, no matter what! $$ディスヌフ$$ will take on these ones and the ones from our world all at once!」

266:t_103:3.en:
$$ノノ$$
「I'm fired up! Big Sis right now... you're just like $$ノノリリ$$!」

266:t_104:0.en:
$n
(The true end that comes once every 120 million years... But apart from that, there's another kind of unease inside me...)

266:t_104:1.en:
$n
(What on earth is it...? Is Miss $$スズネ$$ feeling it too...?)
